Clip tensor values to a scalar range.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TensorClip` |
| Search words | tensor, clip, clamp, elementwise |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor whose values will be clamped |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Clamped tensor with the same shape |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Range | Minimum | `min` | Number | `0.0` |   | The run | Inclusive lower bound. |
| Range | Maximum | `max` | Number | `1.0` |   | The run | Inclusive upper bound. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: TensorClip is a tensor graph math node; PipelineExecutor tensor math execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as an elementwise tensor layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
